title: MCP servers
discovery.notGrant: Finding tools only lists what a server offers. It does not give any access.
perm.levelsNote: Only read-only tools can be allowed, in chat or for collection. Per-tool approval levels are not available yet.
description: Connect outside MCP servers and choose what each may do.
connection.order: Save → test the connection → find tools → choose what each tool may do → turn on
source.listBound: The source list shows up to 1,000 sources. If you have more, use search to find the rest.
scopeBoundsHelp: Each permission can cover up to 100 sources and 8 destinations. Destination IDs can be up to 255 characters each.
inbound.bounds: Limits: 1–3 tools, up to 100 sources and up to 20 labels (80 characters each).
name: Name
transport.label: Transport
profile.adminOnly: Enter the ID your administrator gave you. Commands, arguments, environment and working folder cannot be set here.
credential.label: Access token
save.disables: Saving creates or updates the connection in a turned-off state, and its earlier check and permission review no longer apply.
save.label: Save draft
health.label: Saved health
stdioCredentialMustRemove: Remove the stored access token before switching to stdio.
discardDraftConfirm: Discard this unsaved draft and switch connections?
rediscover.toReview: Tool details are not kept in your browser. Find tools again to review the current ones.
readOnlyGrant: Can only be allowed as a read-only permission, in chat or for collection
unsupported.kind: Cannot be turned on: resource templates are not supported yet
source.scopeNote: Sources that stay on this device are left out and cannot be shared with a remote server.
destinationPlaceholder: Enter destination IDs you have reviewed
optionalExpiry: Optional expiry (local time; timezone is applied by browser)
destinationPrivacy: Destination IDs say where data may be sent. They are separate from the privacy setting that keeps a source on this device. Nothing is added automatically.
collection.destination: Collection always uses the built-in local destination.
collection.sourceLimit: A collection permission must cover exactly one source.
empty.grantWarning: Saving with nothing selected removes every permission for this connection. Continue only if you mean to.
confirm.discover: Find tools on the remote server?
rediscover.confirm: If the server changed its tools, existing permissions may stop applying. Continue?
collection.unavailable: Read-only MCP collection runs on its reviewed schedule. Resource templates and actions that change data are not supported.
manageCollectionSources: Configure MCP sources in Data sources
inbound.description: Issue a separately scoped token for the native endpoint. Tokens are shown once and cannot be recovered.
capabilityNoInference: Labels only describe what the client is for. They are not wildcards, and an empty list does not guarantee a tool will work.
noRemoteSources: No active sources can be shared with remote clients.
rotate.label: Rotate token
revoke.label: Revoke
token.once: Token for {name} (prefix {prefix}) is visible only now.
clipboardNotAcceptance: Copying does not confirm that an external client has accepted the credential.
rotate.warning: The current token will be revoked and replaced. The new token is returned once; an ambiguous result cannot be retried safely.
revoke.warning: Future requests using this client token will be rejected.
dismissWarning: The token will be cleared from this page and cannot be recovered. Confirm only after saving it securely.
confirm.label: Confirm
inbound.required: Enter a name, a future expiry date and at least one supported tool.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
conflict: This connection changed on the server. Your draft is kept; reload and review the server version before editing again.
catalogFull: Your connection list is full or busy. Remove unused connections and try again; this is not a version conflict.
invalidInput: The server rejected some fields. Check the connection details and the requirements for turning it on.
runtimeRefreshFailed: The change was saved, but the connection could not be refreshed, so it may not be working yet. Check the state shown before continuing.
reconciliation.required: A previous change may have been saved while the refresh failed. Changes are paused until the saved state is reloaded.
reconciliation.failed: The saved state could not be reloaded. Changes stay paused; try again before continuing.
transport.unavailable: MCP transport or runtime is unavailable.
clipboardFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select and copy the visible token manually.
grant.scopeRequired: Each selected permission needs at least one active shareable source, a future expiry if you set one, and 1–8 unique destination IDs.
draftRetained: Your unsaved draft is preserved for review.
reloadDiscard: Reload server version and discard draft
copyAcknowledgement: I have securely saved this token and understand it cannot be recovered.
token.ackRequired: A one-time token is still visible. Acknowledge secure storage and dismiss it before leaving this page.
